title: Where the balance moved
description: Floating changes bridge opening and closing balances, with exact zero-based totals and signed readings.

props.name: data
props.description: Caller-ordered { id, label, kind, value } steps. Start and change kinds accept a finite signed value or null; total steps have no value and read the derived running balance. IDs must be unique and nonempty. Missing or overflowing changes break the chain until an explicit start. Zero has a tick, never a minimum-height bar. Color encodes direction only.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned heading; defaults to Change in balance.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned reporting context, units or statistical policy.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats absolute readings and tooltip values; axis ticks use compact numbers. Defaults to en-US with up to two decimals.

props.name: deltaFormatter
props.description: Formats change readings separately from balances. The default includes a plus sign for positive changes.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plots and keys scroll inside the frame.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native drawing using scoped motion tokens and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible title for the native chart.
